input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: The licence grant in Section 2(a) is non-exclusive and expressly preserves Client's freedom to develop or licence competing systems, so there is no general exclusivity problem. However, Section 3(i) imposes a mandatory sole-source purchasing obligation on Client: for every borrower underwritten through a System using the Interface, Client "shall order TrueLink a credit report". That is a requirements/tie-in commitment binding us for the full term, with no cap on scope and no exit if TrueLink fails to meet the response-time, availability or support commitments in Sections 3 and 4 — worse than our fallback and close to the walk-away position. The minimal fix makes the order optional and confirms no exclusive or sole-source purchasing obligation, with a fallback of a 12-month, category-limited commitment terminating on TrueLink's performance failure. Exclusivity running the other way (e.g. TrueLink's obligations) is untouched.

ops.oldText: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
ops.newText: Subject to the foregoing, Client may, at its option, order from TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface, and nothing in this Agreement shall obligate Client to purchase credit reports or any other products or services from TrueLink on an exclusive or sole-source basis.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the credit report order optional rather than mandatory, because our playbook does not permit sole-source or exclusive purchasing obligations on us. If TrueLink needs volume certainty, we can instead limit any commitment to credit reports for a 12-month period, ending automatically if TrueLink fails to meet the response time, availability or support commitments in Sections 3 and 4.
proposal.summary: Convert the mandatory "Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower" tie into an optional right and confirm no exclusive/sole-source purchase obligation on Client.
